name: property-inspector-panel
description: Tabbed property inspector panel featuring editable entity title, Content/Style/Events tab switching, real-time property search, collapsible accordion sections, and JS expression toggle triggers.

visual_references.purpose: property pane with Content and Style tabs, search input, and collapsible section cards
